name: balefireict/component-numbered-features
description: Numbered Features — 'why choose us' section: eyebrow, heading, copy and buttons with numbered points. Stack layout: header above a 2-up hover grid (hover swaps the number for an image). Split layout: intro column beside an editorial index of rows that can link out with their own icon and accent. Ported from the Project B&T Figma ('Simple Text Blocks' frame, node 2030:1841).
